title: Zerox Agent v3.9.2 Conversation Progressive Disclosure
invariants: Goal acceptance and certificate state, Plan lineage, ToolAuthorizationService, Tool Invocation lifecycle, workspace guards, and sandbox enforcement remain authoritative in their existing domains.
Conversation disclosure is a rebuildable projection with stable source references; it is not a new universal fact store.
Required gates and terminal state are persisted by their owning domain before the projection publishes a settled item.
Renderer state may expand, pin, select, or filter an item but may not decide lifecycle, sensitivity, attention, authorization, or evidence identity.
Every default summary is safe and useful; technical or restricted evidence is bounded, redacted, authorized, and reached by stable identity rather than Chat text parsing.
Snapshot and delta consumers detect generation or cursor gaps and reload instead of guessing; partial or degraded evidence coverage is explicit.
Every typed adapter preserves exact domain status requiredness durability and source revision; composite items distinguish one primary source from bounded contributors.
Window reload may recover process-live gates, while main-process restart or cold start reconciles unresolved privileged work to interrupted and requires a new explicit attempt.
Legacy v3.9.1 sessions remain readable and rollback never deletes or rewrites authoritative Chat, Goal, Plan, Run, Trajectory, tool, checkpoint, or artifact data.
Private raw chain of thought and credentials are never product disclosure requirements.
No production surface cuts over before shadow parity, focused tests, compatibility evidence, and its declared rollback gate pass.
nonGoals: No cloud worker, external subagent provider, or remote persistence service.
No replacement of Goal, Plan, ToolAuthorizationService, Tool Invocation, AgentRun, Trajectory, or Chat message authority.
No direct port of DeepSeek Harness WebSocket Host topology, Cordis fiber slot runtime, or pre-release disk compatibility policy.
No default persistence or display of complete reasoning, raw tool arguments, file contents, or secrets.
No turn-local Todo semantics substituted for durable Goal Plan and acceptance contracts.
No arbitrary Code Mode, permission bypass, unreviewed self-modification, or visual big-bang rewrite.
